scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

local AimSlope = 0.35
local AimCosine = 1 / math.sqrt(1 + AimSlope * AimSlope)
local AimSine = AimSlope * AimCosine
local LaunchUp = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
local LaunchForward = 3

local function PredictionVelocity(Target, Profile)
	local Velocity = Target.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	return Profile.Speed and Velocity.Magnitude < math.min(120, Profile.Speed * AimCosine) and Velocity or Vector3.zero
end

local function ProjectileAim(Position, Target, Velocity, Profile)
	local Offset = Target - Position - LaunchUp
	local Distance = Offset:Dot(Offset) - LaunchForward * LaunchForward
	if Distance <= 0 or not Profile.Speed or Profile.Speed <= 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local Coefficient = Velocity:Dot(Velocity) - Profile.Speed * Profile.Speed
	local Linear = 2 * (Offset:Dot(Velocity) - LaunchForward * Profile.Speed)
	local Discriminant = Linear * Linear - 4 * Coefficient * Distance
	if Coefficient >= 0 or Discriminant < 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local Time = 2 * Distance / (math.sqrt(Discriminant) - Linear)
	if Time < 0 or Time * Profile.Speed > Profile.Range + 0.00001 then
		return nil
	end
	local Hit = Target + Velocity * Time
	local Direction = Hit - Position - LaunchUp
	local Horizontal = Vector3.new(Direction.X, 0, Direction.Z).Magnitude
	if Horizontal < 1 or math.abs(Direction.Y) > Horizontal * AimSlope + 0.00001 then
		return nil
	end
	return Hit - LaunchUp
end

function Suite.CloseDialog(Self)
	local Dialog = Self.OwnedDialog
	Self.OwnedDialog = nil
	if Dialog and Dialog.Parent then
		Dialog.Visible = false
	end
end

function Suite.SetDepth(Self, Value)
	if type(Value) ~= "number" or Value ~= Value or math.abs(Value) == math.huge then
		return
	end
	Self.Depth = math.clamp(math.floor(Value * 2 + 0.5) / 2, 1, 50)
	local Control = Self.Controls and Self.Controls.Depth
	if Control and Control:Get() ~= Self.Depth then
		Control:Set(Self.Depth)
	end
end

function Suite.StopMotion(Self, ReturnToSurface)
	local Motion = Self.Motion
	if not Motion then
		return
	end
	Self.Motion = nil
	for Index, Connection in Motion.Connections do
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(Motion.Connections)
	local SameCharacter = Player.Character == Motion.Character and Motion.Root.Parent and Motion.Humanoid.Parent == Motion.Character
	if ReturnToSurface and SameCharacter and Motion.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not Motion.Root.Anchored and Player:GetAttribute("Warping") ~= true then
		local Exit = Motion.ReturnFrame
		if Motion.LastCombatPosition then
			local Surface = Self:Ground(Motion.LastCombatPosition + Vector3.new(10, 0, 0))
			if Surface then
				Exit = CFrame.new(Surface) * Motion.Upright
			end
		end
		Motion.Root.CFrame = Exit
		Motion.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		Motion.Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
	if Motion.Velocity then
		Motion.Velocity:Destroy()
	end
	if Motion.Attachment then
		Motion.Attachment:Destroy()
	end
	for PartObject, CanCollide in Motion.Parts do
		pcall(function()
			if PartObject.CanCollide == false then
				PartObject.CanCollide = CanCollide
			end
		end)
	end
	if Motion.Humanoid.Parent then
		if Motion.Humanoid.AutoRotate == false then
			Motion.Humanoid.AutoRotate = Motion.AutoRotate
		end
		if Motion.Humanoid.PlatformStand == true then
			Motion.Humanoid.PlatformStand = Motion.PlatformStand
		end
		if SameCharacter and Motion.Humanoid.Health > 0 and not Motion.Humanoid.PlatformStand and not Motion.Root.Anchored then
			Motion.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		end
	end
end

function Suite.MotionStep(Self)
	local Motion = Self.Motion
	if not Motion then
		return
	end
	if Self.Dead or not Self.Flags.Farm or Player.Character ~= Motion.Character or not Motion.Root.Parent or Motion.Humanoid.Parent ~= Motion.Character or not Motion.Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or Motion.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		Self:StopMotion(false)
		return
	end
	if Player:GetAttribute("Warping") == true or Player:GetAttribute("InCreation") ~= false then
		Self:StopMotion(false)
		return
	end
	local Held = Self.Native.Kit.isHolding()
	Motion.Velocity.Enabled = not Held
	if Held or Motion.Root.Anchored then
		return
	end
	local Target = Motion.Target
	if Target and not Self:ValidEnemy(Target) then
		Motion.Target = nil
		Target = nil
	end
	local Profile = Motion.Profile
	if Target and Profile and not Self.Paused then
		local Forward = Vector3.new(Target.Root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Target.Root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
		if Forward.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			Target.Forward = Forward.Unit
		end
		Forward = Target.Forward or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		local Rise = Self.Depth + 0.6 - LaunchUp.Y
		local Offset = 4 * Profile.Reach
		local Velocity = PredictionVelocity(Target, Profile)
		Motion.Aim = nil
		if Profile.Projectile and Profile.Speed and Profile.Speed > 0 then
			local Earliest = 0.001 / Profile.Speed
			local Latest = Profile.Range / Profile.Speed
			for Index = 1, 2 do
				local Sign = Index == 1 and 1 or -1
				local Rate = Sign * Velocity.Y - AimSine * Profile.Speed
				local Bound = LaunchForward * AimSine - Sign * Rise
				if math.abs(Rate) < 0.00000001 then
					if Bound < 0 then
						Latest = -1
					end
				elseif Rate > 0 then
					Latest = math.min(Latest, Bound / Rate)
				else
					Earliest = math.max(Earliest, Bound / Rate)
				end
			end
			Offset = math.max(math.abs(Rise) / AimSlope, math.sqrt(math.max(0, LaunchForward * LaunchForward - Rise * Rise))) + 0.001
			if Earliest <= Latest then
				local Length = LaunchForward + Profile.Speed * Earliest
				local Vertical = Rise + Velocity.Y * Earliest
				local Along = Velocity:Dot(Forward)
				local Across = Vector3.new(Velocity.X, 0, Velocity.Z) - Forward * Along
				local Squared = Length * Length - Vertical * Vertical - Across:Dot(Across) * Earliest * Earliest
				if Squared >= 0 then
					Offset = Along * Earliest + math.sqrt(Squared) + 0.001
				end
			end
		end
		Motion.LastCombatPosition = Target.Root.Position
		Motion.Position = Target.Root.Position + Forward * Offset - Vector3.new(0, Self.Depth, 0)
		Motion.Upright = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, -Forward)
		if Profile.Projectile then
			Motion.Aim = ProjectileAim(Motion.Position, Target.Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), Velocity, Profile)
		end
	end
	for PartObject in Motion.Parts do
		if PartObject.CanCollide then
			PartObject.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	Motion.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	Motion.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	Motion.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Motion.Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	if (not Target or Self.Paused) and Motion.Root.CFrame.UpVector.Y > 0.999 then
		Motion.Upright = Motion.Root.CFrame.Rotation
	end
	Motion.Root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Motion.Position) * Motion.Upright
end

function Suite.EnsureMotion(Self)
	if Self.Motion then
		if Self.Motion.Character == Self.Character and Self.Motion.Root == Self.Root and Self.Motion.Humanoid == Self.Humanoid then
			return true
		end
		Self:StopMotion(false)
	end
	if not Self.Flags.Farm or not Self.Root or not Self.Humanoid or Self.Root.Anchored or Self.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	local Direction = Vector3.new(Self.Root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Self.Root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	local Upright = Direction.Magnitude > 0.001 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Direction) or CFrame.new()
	local Motion = {
		Character = Self.Character,
		Root = Self.Root,
		Humanoid = Self.Humanoid,
		AutoRotate = Self.Humanoid.AutoRotate,
		PlatformStand = Self.Humanoid.PlatformStand,
		ReturnFrame = CFrame.new(Self.Root.Position) * Upright,
		Upright = Upright,
		Position = Self.Root.Position,
		Connections = {},
		Parts = {}
	}
	Self.Motion = Motion
	local function Register(Object)
		if Object:IsA("BasePart") and Motion.Parts[Object] == nil then
			Motion.Parts[Object] = Object.CanCollide
			Object.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
	for Index, Object in Motion.Character:GetDescendants() do
		Register(Object)
	end
	table.insert(Motion.Connections, Motion.Character.DescendantAdded:Connect(Register))
	table.insert(Motion.Connections, Motion.Character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(Object)
		local CanCollide = Motion.Parts[Object]
		if CanCollide ~= nil then
			if Object.CanCollide == false then
				Object.CanCollide = CanCollide
			end
			Motion.Parts[Object] = nil
		end
	end))
	local Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	Attachment.Name = "CloverFarmAttachment"
	Attachment.Parent = Motion.Root
	Motion.Attachment = Attachment
	local Velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	Velocity.Name = "CloverFarmFloat"
	Velocity.Attachment0 = Attachment
	Velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	Velocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	Velocity.ForceLimitsEnabled = true
	Velocity.MaxForce = 100000000
	Velocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Velocity.Parent = Motion.Root
	Motion.Velocity = Velocity
	table.insert(Motion.Connections, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
		Self:MotionStep()
	end))
	Self:MotionStep()
	return true
end

function Suite.StopFollowing(Self)
	if Self.Motion then
		Self.Motion.Target = nil
		Self.Motion.Profile = nil
		Self.Motion.Aim = nil
	end
end

function Suite.CancelWork(Self)
	Self:StopMotion(true)
	Self.PendingQuest = nil
	Self.Target = nil
	Self:CloseDialog()
end

function Suite.Set(Self, Key, Value)
	if Self.Flags[Key] == nil then
		return
	end
	local Control = Self.Controls and Self.Controls[Key]
	if Control and Control:Get() ~= (Value == true) then
		Control:Set(Value == true)
		return
	end
	Self.Flags[Key] = Value == true
	if Key == "Farm" and not Value then
		Self:CancelWork()
	end
end

function Suite.Destroy(Self)
	if Self.Dead then
		return
	end
	Self.Dead = true
	Self:CancelWork()
	for Index, Connection in Self.Connections do
		Connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(Self.Connections)
	if Self.EnemyConnections then
		for Index, Connection in Self.EnemyConnections do
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(Self.EnemyConnections)
	end
	for Model, Record in Self.Enemies do
		for Index, Connection in Record.Connections do
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(Record.Connections)
	end
	table.clear(Self.Enemies)
	if Self.AimAdapter and Self.Native.Combat and Self.Native.Combat.aim == Self.AimAdapter then
		Self.Native.Combat.aim = Self.OriginalAim
	end
	if Self.Library then
		pcall(Self.Library.Destroy, Self.Library)
	end
end

function Suite.LoadNative(Self)
	if Self.NativeReady or os.clock() < Self.NextLoad then
		return
	end
	Self.NextLoad = os.clock() + 2
	Player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
	local Data = Shared and Shared:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local Scripts = Player and Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerScripts")
	local Client = Scripts and Scripts:FindFirstChild("Client")
	local Controllers = Client and Client:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
	local Effects = Client and Client:FindFirstChild("VFX")
	local M1 = Effects and Effects:FindFirstChild("M1")
	local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	local Quest = Remotes and Remotes:FindFirstChild("Quest")
	local Dialog = Remotes and Remotes:FindFirstChild("Dialog")
	if not Data or not Controllers or not Quest or not Dialog then
		return
	end
	local Ready = true
	Self.NativeStatus = "Waiting for native systems"
	for Key, Path in {
		State = {Client, "State"},
		Combat = {Controllers, "CombatController"},
		HubRules = {Client, "HubRules"},
		Kit = {Effects, "Kit"},
		Flight = {Client, "Flight"},
		Tune = {M1, "Tune"},
		Weapons = {Data, "Weapons"},
		Quests = {Data, "Quests"},
		Enemies = {Data, "Enemies"},
		World = {Data, "World"},
		Regions = {Data, "Regions"},
		Styles = {Data, "FightingStyles"},
		Blades = {Data, "AntiMagicBlades"},
		Realm = {Shared, "Realm"},
		Config = {Shared, "Config"}
	} do
		if not Self.Native[Key] then
			local Object = Path[1] and Path[1]:FindFirstChild(Path[2])
			if Object and Object:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local Success, Result = pcall(require, Object)
				if Self.Dead then
					return
				end
				if Success and type(Result) == "table" then
					Self.Native[Key] = Result
				else
					Self.NativeStatus = Key .. ": " .. string.sub(tostring(Result), 1, 120)
				end
			end
		end
		if not Self.Native[Key] then
			Ready = false
		end
	end
	if not Ready then
		return
	end
	local Combat = Self.Native.Combat
	Self.OriginalAim = Combat.aim
	Self.AimAdapter = function(...)
		if not Self.Dead and Self.AttackThread == coroutine.running() and Self.AttackAim then
			return Self.AttackAim
		end
		return Self.OriginalAim(...)
	end
	Combat.aim = Self.AimAdapter
	Self.QuestRemote = Quest
	table.insert(Self.Connections, Dialog.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(Kind, City)
		local Pending = Self.PendingQuest
		if Pending and Pending.Kind == "Accept" and Kind == "Quest" and City == Pending.Quest.city then
			Pending.Authorized = true
		end
	end))
	table.insert(Self.Connections, Self.Native.State.changed:Connect(function()
		Self.Target = nil
	end))
	Self.NativeStatus = "Native combat and quest systems ready"
	Self.NativeReady = true
end

function Suite.TrackEnemy(Self, Model)
	if not Model:IsA("Model") or Self.Enemies[Model] then
		return
	end
	local Record = {Model = Model, Connections = {}}
	Self.Enemies[Model] = Record
	local function Refresh()
		Record.Id = Model:GetAttribute("EnemyId")
		Record.Root = Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		Record.Humanoid = Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	end
	Refresh()
	table.insert(Record.Connections, Model.ChildAdded:Connect(Refresh))
	table.insert(Record.Connections, Model.ChildRemoved:Connect(Refresh))
	table.insert(Record.Connections, Model:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EnemyId"):Connect(Refresh))
	table.insert(Record.Connections, Model.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if Model.Parent ~= Self.EnemyFolder then
			for Index, Connection in Record.Connections do
				Connection:Disconnect()
			end
			table.clear(Record.Connections)
			Self.Enemies[Model] = nil
			if Self.Target == Record then
				Self.Target = nil
			end
		end
	end))
end

function Suite.TrackWorld(Self)
	local Folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
	if Folder == Self.EnemyFolder then
		return
	end
	if Self.EnemyConnections then
		for Index, Connection in Self.EnemyConnections do
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(Self.EnemyConnections)
	end
	for Model, Record in Self.Enemies do
		for Index, Connection in Record.Connections do
			Connection:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(Record.Connections)
	end
	table.clear(Self.Enemies)
	Self.EnemyFolder = Folder
	if not Folder then
		return
	end
	Self.EnemyConnections = {}
	for Index, Model in Folder:GetChildren() do
		Self:TrackEnemy(Model)
	end
	table.insert(Self.EnemyConnections, Folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(Model)
		Self:TrackEnemy(Model)
	end))
end

function Suite.ValidEnemy(Self, Record, EnemyId)
	if not Record or not Record.Root or not Record.Humanoid or Record.Model.Parent ~= Self.EnemyFolder then
		return false
	end
	if not Record.Root:IsA("BasePart") or Record.Humanoid.Health <= 0 or type(Record.Id) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	if EnemyId and Record.Id ~= EnemyId then
		return false
	end
	if Record.Model:GetAttribute("TrainingDummy") == true or Record.Model:GetAttribute("Immortal") == true or Record.Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
		return false
	end
	local Protection = Record.Model:GetAttribute("Untouchable")
	if type(Protection) == "number" and math.abs(Protection) < math.huge and Protection > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then
		return false
	end
	return Self.Native.Enemies.get(Record.Id) ~= nil
end

function Suite.Sight(Self, Root, Target, Position)
	local Parameters = RaycastParams.new()
	Parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local Excluded = {Self.Character, Target.Model}
	local Effects = workspace:FindFirstChild("ClientFX")
	if Effects then
		table.insert(Excluded, Effects)
	end
	Parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = Excluded
	Parameters.RespectCanCollide = true
	Parameters.IgnoreWater = true
	local Origin = Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0)
	return workspace:Raycast(Origin, Position - Origin, Parameters) == nil
end

function Suite.EnsureWeapon(Self, Profile)
	local Current = Self.Native.State.slot
	local Desired = Self.Slot
	if Desired == "Auto" then
		if Current == "Melee" or Current == "Sword" or Current == "Grimoire" then
			return true
		end
		Desired = Profile.equipped and Profile.equipped.sword and "Sword" or "Melee"
	end
	if Desired == "Sword" and not (Profile.equipped and Profile.equipped.sword) then
		Self.CombatStatus = "Equip or buy a sword, or select Auto/Melee"
		return false
	end
	if Desired == "Grimoire" and not Profile.grimoire then
		Self.CombatStatus = "Obtain a grimoire, or select Auto/Melee"
		return false
	end
	if Current ~= Desired then
		if os.clock() >= (Self.NextEquip or 0) then
			Self.NextEquip = os.clock() + 1
			Self.Native.Combat.selectSlot(Desired)
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function Suite.AttackProfile(Self)
	local Native = Self.Native
	if not Self.NativeReady then
		return nil
	end
	local Weapon = Native.Weapons.get(Native.State.currentWeaponId())
	if not Weapon then
		return nil
	end
	local Form = Native.Weapons.armourForm(Weapon.id, Player:GetAttribute("Buff"))
	local Style = Native.Styles.m1(Weapon.id)
	local Blade = Native.Blades.m1For(Player, Weapon, Player:GetAttribute("SwordSummoned") == true)
	local Bolt = Weapon.kind == "Grimoire" and Weapon.blade == nil and Form == nil
	local Slash = Blade and Blade.kind == "slash"
	local Reach = Blade and Blade.reach or Style and Style.reach or (Weapon.kind == "Sword" or Weapon.blade or Form == "blade" or Form == "claw") and 1.3 or Form == "fist" and (Native.Weapons.armourReach(Player:GetAttribute("Buff")) or 1.45) or Form == "thunder" and 1.2 or 1
	local Cooldown = Bolt and Native.Config.BOLT_COOLDOWN or Form == "thunder" and 0.22 or Form == "claw" and 0.3 or Blade and Blade.cooldown or Style and Style.cooldown or Native.Config.M1_COOLDOWN
	local Range, Speed
	if Bolt then
		local Tune = Native.Tune.bolt
		Range = (Tune and Tune.range or 85) * Native.Config.PROJECTILE_RANGE
		Speed = Tune and Tune.speed or 150
	elseif Slash then
		Range = Blade.range * Native.Config.PROJECTILE_RANGE
		Speed = Blade.speed
	else
		Range = 10 * Reach
	end
	return {Reach = Reach, Range = Range, Cooldown = math.max(0.1, Cooldown), Projectile = Bolt or Slash, Speed = Speed}
end

function Suite.InReach(Self, Record, Root, Profile)
	local Offset = Record.Root.Position - Root.Position
	if Self.Flags.Farm and Self.Motion and Self.Motion.Target == Record and Profile.Projectile then
		return Self.Motion.Aim ~= nil
	end
	if Offset.Magnitude > Profile.Range + (Profile.Projectile and LaunchForward + LaunchUp.Magnitude or 0) then
		return false
	end
	if Self.Flags.Farm and Self.Motion and Self.Motion.Target == Record then
		return true
	end
	if Profile.Projectile then
		local Aim = ProjectileAim(Root.Position, Record.Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0), PredictionVelocity(Record, Profile), Profile)
		return Aim ~= nil and Self:Sight(Root, Record, Aim + LaunchUp)
	end
	if math.abs(Offset.Y) > 4 * Profile.Reach then
		return false
	end
	return Self:Sight(Root, Record, Record.Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0))
end

function Suite.FindEnemy(Self, Root, Profile, EnemyId)
	local Best, Cost
	for Model, Record in Self.Enemies do
		if Self:ValidEnemy(Record, EnemyId) then
			local Distance = (Record.Root.Position - Root.Position).Magnitude
			if (EnemyId ~= nil or Self:InReach(Record, Root, Profile)) and (not Cost or Distance < Cost) then
				Best = Record
				Cost = Distance
			end
		end
	end
	return Best
end

function Suite.Attack(Self, Record, Root, Profile)
	if not Self:ValidEnemy(Record) then
		return false
	end
	if not Self:InReach(Record, Root, Profile) then
		Self.CombatStatus = Profile.Projectile and "Depth or target motion is outside native projectile limits" or "Selected depth is outside native weapon reach"
		return false
	end
	if os.clock() < Self.NextAttack then
		return false
	end
	if Self.Native.Combat.busy() or Player:GetAttribute("SummonLock") == true then
		return false
	end
	local Aim = Record.Root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	if Profile.Projectile then
		if Self.Flags.Farm and Self.Motion and Self.Motion.Target == Record then
			Aim = Self.Motion.Aim
		else
			Aim = ProjectileAim(Root.Position, Aim, PredictionVelocity(Record, Profile), Profile)
		end
		if not Aim then
			Self.CombatStatus = "No native projectile path to the target"
			return false
		end
	end
	Self.AttackThread = coroutine.running()
	Self.AttackAim = Aim
	local Success, Result = pcall(Self.Native.Combat.m1)
	Self.AttackAim = nil
	Self.AttackThread = nil
	Self.NextAttack = os.clock() + Profile.Cooldown
	Self.CombatStatus = Success and "Attacking " .. Record.Model.Name or "Combat error: " .. string.sub(tostring(Result), 1, 100)
	return Success
end

function Suite.ChooseQuest(Self, Profile)
	local Best
	local CurrentRealm = Self.Native.Realm.current()
	for Index, Quest in Self.Native.Quests.all do
		local Definition = Self.Native.Enemies.get(Quest.enemy)
		local Region = Self.Native.Regions.get(Quest.city)
		local Realm = Region and Region.realm or Self.Native.World.getCity(Quest.city) and CurrentRealm
		local Boss = Definition and Definition.boss == true
		if Definition and Realm == CurrentRealm and Quest.minLevel <= Profile.level and (Self.Flags.Bosses or not Boss) and os.clock() >= (Self.QuestBlocked[Quest.id] or 0) then
			if not Best or Quest.minLevel > Best.minLevel or Quest.minLevel == Best.minLevel and Quest.id < Best.id then
				Best = Quest
			end
		end
	end
	return Best
end

function Suite.Ground(Self, Position)
	local Parameters = RaycastParams.new()
	Parameters.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local Excluded = {Self.Character}
	for Index, Name in {"Enemies", "NPCs", "Townsfolk", "RegionNPCs", "ClientFX", "TeacherNpcs", "Familiars"} do
		local Object = workspace:FindFirstChild(Name)
		if Object then
			table.insert(Excluded, Object)
		end
	end
	Parameters.FilterDescendantsInstances = Excluded
	Parameters.RespectCanCollide = true
	Parameters.IgnoreWater = false
	local Origin = Vector3.new(Position.X, math.max(Position.Y + 120, 160), Position.Z)
	local Best, Cost
	local Lift = Self.Humanoid.HipHeight + Self.Root.Size.Y * 0.5
	for Index = 1, 8 do
		local Hit = workspace:Raycast(Origin, Vector3.new(0, -(Origin.Y + 100), 0), Parameters)
		if not Hit then
			break
		end
		if Hit.Material == Enum.Material.Water and not Best then
			return nil
		end
		if Hit.Normal.Y >= 0.55 and Hit.Material ~= Enum.Material.Water then
			local Distance = math.abs(Hit.Position.Y + Lift - Position.Y)
			if not Cost or Distance < Cost then
				Best = Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, Lift, 0)
				Cost = Distance
			end
			if Distance < 8 then
				return Best
			end
		end
		if Hit.Position.Y >= Origin.Y then
			break
		end
		Origin = Vector3.new(Position.X, Hit.Position.Y - 0.1, Position.Z)
	end
	return Best
end

function Suite.RequestStream(Self, Position)
	if os.clock() < Self.NextStream then
		return
	end
	Self.NextStream = os.clock() + 2
	task.spawn(function()
		if not Self.Dead then
			pcall(Player.RequestStreamAroundAsync, Player, Position, 2)
		end
	end)
end

function Suite.Travel(Self, Position)
	if not Self:EnsureMotion() then
		Self.Status = "Waiting for character movement control"
		return false
	end
	Self:RequestStream(Position)
	local Ground = Self:Ground(Position)
	local Destination = Ground or Position + Vector3.new(0, Self.Humanoid.HipHeight + Self.Root.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
	Self.Motion.Target = nil
	Self.Motion.Profile = nil
	Self.Motion.Aim = nil
	Self.Motion.Position = Destination
	Self.Root.CFrame = CFrame.new(Destination) * Self.Motion.Upright
	Self.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	Self.Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	if Ground then
		Self.Motion.ReturnFrame = Self.Root.CFrame
	end
	return true
end

function Suite.Giver(Self, Quest)
	local Known = ReplicatedStorage:GetAttribute("NpcSpot_" .. Quest.city .. "_Quest")
	local NearbyPosition, NearbyPrompt, NearbyDistance
	for Index, FolderName in {"NPCs", "RegionNPCs"} do
		local Folder = workspace:FindFirstChild(FolderName)
		if Folder then
			for Position, Model in Folder:GetChildren() do
				if Model:IsA("Model") then
					local Root = Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Model.PrimaryPart or Model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local Prompt = Model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
					if Root and Prompt and Prompt.Enabled then
						if Model:GetAttribute("City") == Quest.city and Model:GetAttribute("NPCKind") == "Quest" then
							return Root.Position, Prompt
						end
						local Distance = typeof(Known) == "Vector3" and (Root.Position - Known).Magnitude
						if Distance and Distance < 8 and Prompt.ActionText == "Talk" and (not NearbyDistance or Distance < NearbyDistance) then
							NearbyPosition = Root.Position
							NearbyPrompt = Prompt
							NearbyDistance = Distance
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if NearbyPrompt then
		return NearbyPosition, NearbyPrompt
	end
	if typeof(Known) == "Vector3" then
		return Known, nil
	end
end

function Suite.GetZone(Self, Quest)
	local Best, Distance
	for Index, Zone in Self.Native.Enemies.zones do
		if Zone.enemy == Quest.enemy then
			local Position = Zone.center
			local Region = Self.Native.Regions.get(Quest.city)
			if Region and Region.minY then
				local Island, Cost
				for Key, Candidate in Self.Native.Regions.islands or {} do
					local Center = Candidate.center
					local Length = Vector3.new(Center.X - Position.X, 0, Center.Z - Position.Z).Magnitude
					if not Cost or Length < Cost then
						Island = Candidate
						Cost = Length
					end
				end
				Position = Vector3.new(Position.X, Island and Island.center.Y or Region.center.Y, Position.Z)
			end
			local Cost = (Position - Self.Root.Position).Magnitude + math.max(0, (Self.ZoneVisits[Zone.id] or 0) - os.clock()) * 20
			if not Distance or Cost < Distance then
				Best = {Position = Position, Id = Zone.id}
				Distance = Cost
			end
		end
	end
	if not Best then
		local Position = Self.Native.Regions.timedSpot(Quest.enemy)
		if Position then
			Best = {Position = Position, Id = Quest.enemy}
		end
	end
	return Best
end

function Suite.QuestRequest(Self, Quest, Profile)
	local Now = os.clock()
	local Pending = Self.PendingQuest
	if Pending then
		if Pending.Authorized and not Pending.Sent then
			local Gui = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
			local Shops = Gui and Gui:FindFirstChild("Shops")
			for Index, Dialog in CollectionService:GetTagged("NpcDialogue") do
				if Shops and Dialog:IsDescendantOf(Shops) and Dialog:IsA("GuiObject") and Dialog.Visible then
					Self.OwnedDialog = Dialog
					break
				end
			end
			Self.QuestRemote:FireServer("accept", Quest.id)
			Pending.Sent = true
			Pending.Started = Now
			Self:CloseDialog()
		end
		if Now - Pending.Started > 5 then
			Self.QuestBlocked[Quest.id] = Now + 15
			Self.PendingQuest = nil
			Self:CloseDialog()
			Self.Status = "Quest not confirmed; waiting before another request"
		else
			Self.Status = Pending.Sent and "Waiting for the server to accept the quest" or "Waiting for the quest-giver dialogue"
		end
		return
	end
	if Profile.lastQuest == Quest.id and Player:GetAttribute("Pass_QuestAnywhere") == true then
		Self.PendingQuest = {Quest = Quest, Kind = "Restart", Sent = true, Started = Now}
		Self.QuestRemote:FireServer("restart")
		return
	end
	local Position, Prompt = Self:Giver(Quest)
	if not Position then
		Self.QuestBlocked[Quest.id] = Now + 10
		Self.Status = "Waiting for the quest-giver location"
		return
	end
	local Range = Prompt and math.max(2, Prompt.MaxActivationDistance - 2) or 9
	if (Position - Self.Root.Position).Magnitude > Range then
		Self.Status = "Travelling to the " .. Quest.city .. " quest giver"
		if not Self:Travel(Position) then
			Self.QuestBlocked[Quest.id] = Now + 20
		end
		return
	end
	Self:StopFollowing()
	if not Prompt then
		Self:RequestStream(Position)
		Self.Status = "Loading the live quest-giver prompt"
		return
	end
	Self.PendingQuest = {Quest = Quest, Kind = "Accept", Started = Now}
	Prompt:InputHoldBegin()
	task.delay(math.max(0, Prompt.HoldDuration) + 0.05, function()
		if Prompt.Parent then
			pcall(Prompt.InputHoldEnd, Prompt)
		end
	end)
end

function Suite.FarmTick(Self, Profile, AttackProfile)
	local Active = Profile.quest
	local Quest = Active and Self.Native.Quests.get(Active.id)
	if Active and not Quest then
		Self:StopFollowing()
		Self.Status = "The active quest is not a supported city kill quest"
		return nil
	end
	if not Active then
		Quest = Self.PendingQuest and Self.PendingQuest.Quest or Self:ChooseQuest(Profile)
		if Quest then
			Self:QuestRequest(Quest, Profile)
		else
			Self.Status = "No eligible quest in this kingdom"
			Self:StopFollowing()
		end
		return nil
	end
	Self.PendingQuest = nil
	Self:CloseDialog()
	if (Active.progress or 0) >= Quest.count then
		Self:StopFollowing()
		Self.Status = "Waiting for confirmed quest completion"
		return nil
	end
	local Record = Self.Target
	local Valid = Self:ValidEnemy(Record, Quest.enemy)
	if not Valid or os.clock() >= (Self.NextTarget or 0) then
		local Candidate = Self:FindEnemy(Self.Root, AttackProfile, Quest.enemy)
		if not Valid or Candidate and (Candidate.Root.Position - Self.Root.Position).Magnitude + 8 < (Record.Root.Position - Self.Root.Position).Magnitude then
			Record = Candidate
		end
		Self.Target = Record
		Self.NextTarget = os.clock() + 0.4
	end
	if Record then
		Self:RequestStream(Record.Root.Position)
		if not Self:EnsureMotion() then
			Self.Status = "Waiting for character movement control"
			return nil
		end
		Self.Motion.Target = Record
		Self.Motion.Profile = AttackProfile
		Self:MotionStep()
		Self.Status = string.format("Farming %s / %.1f studs below", Record.Model.Name, Self.Depth)
		return Record
	end
	if os.clock() < (Self.NextScout or 0) then
		Self.Status = "Waiting for " .. Quest.enemy .. " to spawn"
		return nil
	end
	local Zone = Self:GetZone(Quest)
	if not Zone then
		Self:StopFollowing()
		Self.Status = "No spawn area available for " .. Quest.enemy
		return nil
	end
	Self.Status = "Loading " .. Quest.enemy .. " spawn area"
	if Self:Travel(Zone.Position) then
		Self.ZoneVisits[Zone.Id] = os.clock() + 8
		Self.NextScout = os.clock() + 1
		Self.Status = "Waiting for " .. Quest.enemy .. " to spawn"
	end
	return nil
end

function Suite.Tick(Self)
	if Self.Dead then
		return
	end
	Self:LoadNative()
	if not Self.NativeReady then
		Self.Status = Self.NativeStatus
		return
	end
	Self:TrackWorld()
	local Character = Player.Character
	local Root = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if Self.Character ~= Character then
		Self:CancelWork()
		Self.Character = Character
	end
	Self.Root = Root
	Self.Humanoid = Humanoid
	local Profile = Self.Native.State.profile
	if not Self.Flags.Farm and not Self.Flags.Aura then
		Self.Status = "Automation off"
		Self.CombatStatus = "Aura off"
		return
	end
	if not Root or not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or not Profile then
		Self:StopMotion(true)
		Self.Status = "Waiting for the character and native profile"
		return
	end
	local Pending = Self.PendingQuest
	Self.Paused = GuiService.MenuIsOpen or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil or Player:GetAttribute("InCreation") ~= false or Player:GetAttribute("Warping") == true or Character:GetAttribute("Possessed") == true or Self.Native.Kit.isHolding() or Self.Native.HubRules.blocked()
	if not (Pending and Pending.Authorized) then
		for Index, Dialog in CollectionService:GetTagged("NpcDialogue") do
			if Dialog:IsA("GuiObject") and Dialog.Visible and Dialog:IsDescendantOf(Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")) then
				Self.Paused = true
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if Self.Paused then
		Self:StopFollowing()
		Self.Status = "Paused for the game menu, character or cinematic state"
		return
	end
	if Root.Anchored then
		Self:StopFollowing()
		Self.Status = "Waiting for native streaming or movement control"
		return
	end
	if Self.Native.Flight.active() then
		if Self.Flags.Farm then
			Self.Native.Combat.land()
		else
			Self:StopFollowing()
			Self.Status = "Automatic actions pause during your manual flight"
			return
		end
	end
	if not Self.Motion and (Humanoid.PlatformStand or Humanoid.Sit) then
		Self.Status = "Waiting for native movement control"
		return
	end
	if not Self:EnsureWeapon(Profile) then
		Self:StopFollowing()
		return
	end
	if not Self.Flags.Farm and os.clock() < Self.NextAttack then
		return
	end
	local AttackProfile = Self:AttackProfile()
	if not AttackProfile then
		Self.Status = "Waiting for an equipped weapon profile"
		return
	end
	local Target
	if Self.Flags.Farm then
		Target = Self:FarmTick(Profile, AttackProfile)
	else
		Self.Status = "Standalone aura active"
	end
	if not Target and Self.Flags.Aura and not Self.Flags.Farm and not Self.PendingQuest then
		Target = Self:FindEnemy(Root, AttackProfile, nil)
	end
	if Target then
		Self:Attack(Target, Root, AttackProfile)
	else
		Self.CombatStatus = "Waiting for a visible enemy in native reach"
	end
end

        return "Groq GPT-OSS Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse Groq GPT-OSS response"
end


local function CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, apiKey)
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
        model = "gpt-4o-mini",
        messages = {{
            role = "user",
            content = userMessage
        }},
        max_tokens = 1024,
        temperature = 0.7
    })
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return request({
            Url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
                ["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. apiKey
            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end
    
    if not response or not response.Body then
        return "Error: No response from server"
    end
    
    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format"
    end
    
    if data and data.choices and data.choices[1] and data.choices[1].message and data.choices[1].message.content then
        return data.choices[1].message.content
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "ChatGPT Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse ChatGPT response"
end


local function CallAI(userMessage)
    if currentAI == "Gemini" then
        return CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Claude" then
        return CallClaudeAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ClaudeApi)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Llama" then
        return CallGroqLlamaAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Gpt Oss" then
        return CallGroqGptOssAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Gpt-4" then
        return CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ChatGptApi)
    else
        return "Please select an AI model from the settings"
    end
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

        animationRunning = false
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function setupCharacter(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://72722244508749"
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)

    screenGui:ClearAllChildren()

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")

    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)

    frame.Active = true
    frame.Draggable = true

    local playBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    playBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    playBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    playBtn.Text = "Play Animation"
    playBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 180)
    playBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    playBtn.Parent = frame

    playBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        animTrack:Play()
    end)

    local keybindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    keybindBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 40)
    keybindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
    keybindBtn.Text = currentKey and ("Set Keybind (Current: " .. tostring(currentKey) .. ")") or "Set Keybind (Current: none)"

    keybindBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

    keybindBtn.Parent = frame

    local waitingForKey = false

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        keybindBtn.Text = "Press a key..."
        waitingForKey = true

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)

            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)

	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end
})


Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function moveToTarget()
    if humanoidRootPart then
        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetPosition
    end
end

local cashRegisters = {}

local safes = {}

local function updateCaches()
    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
            if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
                table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
            elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
                table.insert(safes, child)
            end
        end
    end
end

updateCaches()

Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            table.insert(safes, child)
        end
    end
end)

Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            for i = #cashRegisters, 1, -1 do
                if cashRegisters[i] == child then
                    table.remove(cashRegisters, i)
                end
            end
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            for i = #safes, 1, -1 do
                if safes[i] == child then
                    table.remove(safes, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not checkCashRegister() then
        checkSafe()
    end
end)

    local isOn = false

    local offColor = button.BackgroundColor3
    local onColor = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)

        button.Text = isOn and textOn or textOff
        local baseColor = isOn and onColor or offColor

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

Queue.__index = Queue
function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

        local byte = tonumber(byte_str, 16)
        text = text .. string.char(byte)

 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end
 return funcs.base64.encode(key)
end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

funcs.newcclosure = function(f)
 local a = coroutine.wrap(function(...)
  local b = {coroutine.yield()}
  while true do
   b = {coroutine.yield(f(table.unpack(b)))}
  end
 end)
 a()
 return a
end -- Credits to myworld AND EMPER for this

funcs.isexecutorclosure = function(fnc)
    local found = false
    for i, v in pairs(getgenv()) do
     if v == fnc then return true end
    end
    for i = 1, math.huge do
        local s, env = pcall(getfenv, i)
        if not s or found then break end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, v in pairs(env) do
                if v == fnc then
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if found then break end
    end

    return found
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

funcs.loadfile = function(path)

 if not content then error('File \'' .. tostring(path) .. '\' does not exist.') return '' end
 local s, func = pcall(function()
  return loadstring(content)
 end)
 return func, not s and func or nil
end

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end

funcs.Drawing.new = function(Type) -- Drawing.new
    local baseProps = {
     Visible = false,
     Color = Color3.new(0,0,0),
     ClassName = nil
    }
    if Type == 'Line' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Square' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = true

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Size = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateSquare = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Size.X, 0, self.Size.Y)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Filled' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Enabled = not value
                a.BackgroundTransparency = value and 0 or 1
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                b.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            elseif key == 'Size' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Circle' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = false
        b.Thickness = 1
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner", a)
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            Filled = false,
            NumSides = 0,
            Radius = 1,
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateCircle = function(self)
             if not b or not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Radius, 0, self.Radius)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
             b.Enabled = not self
             b.Color = self.Color
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Thickness = value
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                a.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            elseif key == 'Radius' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            elseif key == 'NumSides' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Filled' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Text' then
        local a = Instance.new("TextLabel", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        a.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
        a.TextStrokeTransparency = 1

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Text = '',
            Transparency = 0,
            Size = 0,
            Center = false,
            Outline = false,
            OutlineColor = Color3.new(0,0,0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Font = 3,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end

function GetMetaMethods(regularTable)
    local meta = getmetatable(regularTable)

function GetFullName(instance)
    local p = instance

    while (p ~= game and p.Parent ~= nil) do

    local fullName

function processTableDescendants(tbl, indent, tblname)
    indent = indent or 0
    tblname = tblname or "{}"
    local metacount = 1
    local result = ""
    local count = 1
    for key, value in pairs(tbl) do
        if type(value) == "table" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. pKey(key) .. " = {"
            if #value == 0 then
                result = result .. "}"
            else
                result = result .. "\n" .. processTableDescendants(value, indent + 1)
                result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. "}\n"
            end
            if getrawmetatable(value) ~= nil then
                result =
                    result ..
                    string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                        "local meta" .. tostring(metacount) .. " = setmetatable(" .. tostring(tblname) .. ", {})\n"
                metacount = metacount + 1
                for _, v in GetMetaMethods(value) do

                    if typeof(v.Value) == "table" then
                        result =
                            result ..
                            string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                                "{" ..
                                    processTableDescendants(v.Value, indent + 1) ..
                                        "\n" .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. "}"
                    elseif typeof(v.Value) == "function" then
                        result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. "function() --[[ Function Source ]] end"
                    else
                        result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. tostring(v.Value)
                    end
                    result = result .. ";\n"
                end
            end
        elseif type(value) == "function" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result =
                result ..
                string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                    pKey(key) .. " = function() --[[Function Source]] end" .. string.rep("  ", indent + 1)
        elseif typeof(value):lower() == "vector3" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result =
                result ..
                string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                    pKey(key) ..
                        " = Vector3.new(" ..
                            tostring(value.X) .. ", " .. tostring(value.Y) .. ", " .. tostring(value.Z) .. ");\n"
        elseif typeof(value):lower() == "vector2" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result =
                result ..
                string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                    pKey(key) .. " = Vector2.new(" .. tostring(value.X) .. ", " .. tostring(value.Y) .. ");\n"
        elseif typeof(value):lower() == "udim" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result =
                result ..
                string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                    pKey(key) .. " = UDim.new(" .. tostring(value.Scale) .. ", " .. tostring(value.Offset) .. ");\n"
        elseif typeof(value):lower() == "udim2" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result =
                result ..
                string.rep("  ", indent) ..
                    pKey(key) ..
                        " = UDim2.new(" ..
                            tostring(value.X.Scale) ..
                                ", " ..
                                    tostring(value.X.Offset) ..
                                        ", " .. tostring(value.Y.Scale) .. ", " .. tostring(value.Y.Offset) .. ");\n"
        elseif typeof(value):lower() == "instance" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. pKey(key) .. " = " .. GetFullName(value) .. ";\n"
        elseif typeof(value) == "string" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. pKey(key) .. ' = "' .. tostring(value) .. '";\n'
        elseif typeof(value) == "number" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then
            result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. pKey(key) .. " = " .. tostring(value) .. ";\n"
        elseif typeof(value) == "nil" and not startswith(tostring(key), "__") then -- nil value
            result = result .. string.rep("  ", indent) .. pKey(key) .. " = " .. tostring(value) .. ";\n"
